name: harness-flow
description: HarnessFlow — a constraint-based workflow for building software products with AI agents: seven invariants (truth on disk, claims need machine evidence, signal before build, green trunk, layered decision rights, independent perspective, reversibility first), three user checkpoints (intent / tradeoff / release), a product truth layout (product/ + work/), and the stdlib-only evidence protocol harness.py. Method is deliberately unprescribed — good workflows emerge inside the constraints.
